fleets.title: Fleet templates
fleets.intro: A fleet template describes a whole heterogeneous fleet — blueprints, scenario templates, EV settings, network simulation and labels per charge point — and creates it in one step. Editing a template never changes a fleet that is already running.
fleets.empty.title: No fleet templates
fleets.empty.hint: Create one with “New template”, or start the daemon with --fleet-template.
fleets.unsupported.title: Fleet templates need a daemon
fleets.unsupported.hint: Templates are stored by the daemon and create charge points through it. Connect the console to a daemon to use them.
fleets.delete.confirm: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Charge points already created from it stay.
fleets.editor.hint: The same JSON a --fleet-template file holds. Saving under an existing id replaces that stored template.
fleets.create.title: Create a fleet from {{name}}
fleets.create.hint: Creates independent charge points, in the template's order.
fleets.create.wsUrlHint: Used for charge points whose line and blueprint name none.
fleets.create.idPrefixHint: Prepended to every charge point id, so one template can be created more than once.
